tool_args.rationale: Fit a smooth saturating input response with bounded gradient suppression and a local square-root contribution, consistent with the base-field and sink-gradient signatures. Fresh confirmation will test whether this stationary mechanism generalizes.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It has no gradient dependence, whereas the observations show substantial gradient-associated suppression.
A simple power law lacks the saturating input and bounded gradient-suppression structure indicated by the observed signatures.
Nine observations are already available at the target horizon; the nuisance probe does not discriminate the relevant mechanisms.
All observed gradients are below the recalled supercritical range, so its parameters are not identifiable from these measurements.
